review_kind: fresh scoped re-review of social feedback error boundary

prior_finding.detail: copySocialTags now imports the actual pollSocialFeedback function. Its awaited read rejection is not caught by the poller or caller. A lost-target/resource exception stops before clipboard and before the runCopyCheckThenRecapture T02 callback. The focused test drives this imported function and observes both callbacks remain untouched.

verdict_A_behavior_readiness.detail: No fresh native SEO/social acceptance run was in scope. The earlier native result still cannot establish actual icon, clipboard or T02 behavior, so this review grants no T02/T14 pass. The source boundary still permits an invalid SEO pane sample to reach clipboard verification.

accepted: Thrown read errors now propagate directly; ordinary bounded false-icon samples remain nonfatal.
The focused guard imports the same poller used by the native driver and would reject the old catch-and-convert behavior.
The negative copy criteria, permission restoration helper and controlled DOM mutation cleanup were unchanged in this commit.

new_findings.title: Invalid SEO pane is accepted as a missed feedback icon
new_findings.detail: socialCopyState returns scopeValid, buttonCount and visible for every sample, but pollSocialFeedback considers only check/failed. If Runtime.evaluate succeeds while the linked SEO pane is gone, inactive, or the copy action disappears, repeated scopeValid:false or buttonCount:0 samples return iconObserved:false. copySocialTags then reads clipboard and can mark T14 pass when its text matches and changed. Only a valid pane with an absent transient icon should continue; invalid pane or missing action should stop clipboard and T02.
new_findings.evidence: A direct probe of the imported poller with {scopeValid:false,buttonCount:0,visible:false,check:false,failed:false,idle:false} returned {iconObserved:false} after the deadline. The new test's missed-icon samples contain only check:false and failed:false, so it cannot reject this state.
new_findings.remedy: Validate every feedback sample's scope and unique visible action before accepting icon absence, then add a focused invalid-pane guard alongside the lost-target case.

verdict_B_quality_and_guards.guard_assessment: The thrown-read regression is covered, but the controlled missed-icon test does not encode the required valid-pane precondition.

checks_run: Direct imported-poller invalid-pane probe: returned iconObserved false instead of rejecting
limits: No build or native run was performed under this review assignment.
No source or inventory files were edited.
